scope.summary: test_sticky_scroll::clicking_sticky_header_scrolls_to_its_line fails with the viewport unchanged (60..73 before and after). The sticky header never reports clicked(), because the editor-body context-menu interaction surface covers the sticky band and is registered AFTER it, so egui last-widget-wins hit resolution routes the click to the context surface.

defect_detail.site: code_editor/panel.rs:8423-8427 builds editor_body_context_rect from full_rect.top(). full_rect is captured at :8186 BEFORE the gutter SidePanel (:8208) and BEFORE render_sticky_band (:8244), so it spans the band. render_editor_context_menu (:9122-9128) registers it with a FULL egui::Sense::click(), not secondary-only.
defect_detail.hit_resolution: egui-0.33.3 hit_test.rs:436-440 - on a tie the LAST widget in the layer wins. The thin-widget escape hatch does not apply: should_prioritize_hits_on_back returns false when front.contains_rect(back) (hit_test.rs:453-456) and the context rect fully contains the header label. Both are in the same layer, so the cross-layer filter (hit_test.rs:141-149) does not apply either.
defect_detail.consequence: panel.rs:9990-10002 never takes the resp.clicked() branch, click_line stays None, and :10038-10042 (record_jump_origin -> buffer_line_to_visible_line -> scroll_to_line) never runs.
defect_detail.the_scroll_plumbing_is_NOT_the_bug: Checked so this is not misattributed: scroll_to_line (:7805-7822) stores pending_scroll_offset and the scroll area consumes it in the SAME frame at :8262-8274 (band renders at :8244, scroll scope at :8249). The request is not computed-then-discarded and not applied to the wrong area - it is never created.
defect_detail.the_line_0_in_the_panic_is_literal_text: The message "scrolled the viewport to its line 0" comes from a format string in tests/test_sticky_scroll.rs:323-326; only before/after are interpolated. There is no computed target-line value, so any "lookup returned a default" theory is false.

acceptance_criteria.AC-132-1: The context rect excludes the sticky band on the Y axis, the same way it already excludes the gutter on X via gutter_rect.right() (:8228). render_sticky_band should return its rect (TopBottomPanel::show_inside yields an InnerResponse) and the context rect should start at its bottom.
acceptance_criteria.AC-132-2: The context menu still opens everywhere it did outside the band. Narrowing the rect must not silently delete the right-click surface.
acceptance_criteria.AC-132-3: test_sticky_scroll green with the viewport range actually changing.
acceptance_criteria.AC-132-4: Add the systemic guard: for a given author_id, assert its AccessKit bounds centre resolves to THAT widget under Context::widget_at / layer_id_at. Node presence and role are exactly what let this ship.

proof_targets.PT-132-2: The AC-132-4 reachability guard, shown RED against the pre-fix shadowing.

scope.risk_if_missed: A real operator cannot click a sticky header to navigate, and the failure is invisible to every proof that checks only node presence.

implementation_result.what_changed: render_sticky_band now returns Option<Rect>, and the editor-body context surface starts at the band bottom instead of full_rect.top() - the Y analogue of the gutter exclusion already present on the X axis.
implementation_result.ac_132_2: MET by construction: the rect was NARROWED by exactly the band strip, so the context menu still covers everything it covered outside the band. test_code_editor_panel 8/0 and the menu suites are unchanged.
implementation_result.ac_132_3: MET - the viewport range now actually changes.
implementation_result.ac_132_4: MET, and proven non-vacuous. tests/native_gui_support/hit_reachability.rs clicks a target at the centre of the bounds it advertises to AccessKit and asserts egui delivered that click to THAT widget. RED proven by restoring only the MT-132 shadowing - the guard reported the click was delivered to a different widget id - then GREEN after restoring the fix.
implementation_result.correction_to_the_original_diagnosis: The "line 0" in the old panic message is LITERAL TEXT in the test format string (test_sticky_scroll.rs:323-326); only before/after are interpolated. Any theory about a target-line lookup returning a default was false, and is recorded here so it is not re-investigated.
implementation_result.status_note: All four acceptance criteria met. test_sticky_scroll 6 passed / 0 failed.
implementation_result.validation_boundary: KERNEL_BUILDER issues NO PASS verdict. Implementation evidence only.
implementation_result.two_earlier_versions_of_the_guard_were_V: Recorded because it is the whole reason a RED proof is mandatory. Reading contains_pointer PASSED with the shadowing restored, because it holds every widget whose rect covers the point (hit_test.rs:20-27 calls it "both a Window and the Button in it"). Reading hovered also PASSED, because it resolves to a set including ancestry. WidgetHits::click is the exact "what would be clicked" answer but has no public accessor, so the guard performs a real press/release and reads InteractionSnapshot::clicked, a single Option<Id>. Two guards that asserted nothing would have shipped without the RED step.
